stem: A finance team needs weekly visualization and forecast of Aurora spend trends, plus a hard monthly notification threshold for the dev account.

choices.text: Use AWS Database Migration Service for forecasting and billing notifications.
Use Cost Explorer for trends and forecasts, then Budgets alerts for the monthly threshold.
Use AWS Backup vault metrics for all database spend analysis and threshold alerting.
Use Amazon CloudWatch alarms on CPU utilization as the only cost forecast and threshold control.

rationale: Cost Explorer is the billing trend and forecast tool, while Budgets provides threshold notifications. DMS handles data migration, not cost analytics. AWS Backup metrics focus on backup operations, not full spend forecasting. CPU alarms monitor performance and cannot replace billing forecasts.
